goal: Specify the implementation contract for a Windows SCM service that owns one registration-bound WSL host server foreground unit, including readiness, recovery, stop, and operator evidence without involving GUI clients.
approach: Add a Go Windows service adapter and pure wslhost controller, plus additive Linux host probe/stop commands. Bind configuration at registration, probe/adopt before spawn, launch directly in the foreground, use typed failure partitions and fixed budgets, and expose structured ProgramData records.

in_scope: Windows Service registration and Session 0 lifecycle for one bound WSL host server
Typed pre-spawn adoption, health/readiness, retry, stop and target-distro escalation
Machine-wide structured records and SCM pre-start failure lookup
Additive host server probe/stop CLI contract
out_of_scope: GUI or Windows Shell client behavior
Windows-native host, containers, cross-OS bridge redesign
Credential broker, session, frame, driver, sandbox, or devcontainer ownership

requirements.statement: While the registered Windows Service is Running, the system shall report Ready only after the configured GET /healthz returns HTTP 200 with status ok; daemon-unavailable, transport success alone, and process existence shall remain non-Ready.
requirements.rationale: Traces the confirmed constraint or UAC scenario associated with FR-WSL-001.

requirements.statement: The supervisor shall keep exactly one registration-bound host server supervised unit in the foreground and shall never leave a launcher or shell process in the supervision chain.
requirements.rationale: Traces the confirmed constraint or UAC scenario associated with FR-WSL-002.

requirements.statement: When the Linux host server exits normally or abnormally, the supervised wsl.exe unit shall exit, the exit code shall be recorded, and no host server or launcher shell shall remain.
requirements.rationale: Traces the confirmed constraint or UAC scenario associated with FR-WSL-003.

requirements.statement: When a transient crash or health failure occurs, the supervisor shall enter Backoff, record the delay and attempt number, retry according to the fixed schedule, and return to Ready only after health succeeds.
requirements.rationale: Traces the confirmed constraint or UAC scenario associated with FR-WSL-004.

requirements.statement: If the same typed configuration failure occurs five consecutive times, the supervisor shall enter terminal Failed, record the specific invalid setting, and issue no further retry until a new applied registration generation or SCM restart resets the transaction.
requirements.rationale: Traces the confirmed constraint or UAC scenario associated with FR-WSL-005.

requirements.statement: When the pre-spawn probe proves that a fingerprint-matched host already holds the registered data-directory lock, the supervisor shall adopt that instance before any spawn, record already-running, and shall not classify it as crash or configuration failure.
requirements.rationale: Traces the confirmed constraint or UAC scenario associated with FR-WSL-006.

requirements.statement: If SCM cannot create the service process because of credentials, Log on as a service, profile, executable ACL, or configuration ACL, the Windows service-start record shall expose a credential or access category and a deterministic operator lookup path.
requirements.rationale: Traces the confirmed constraint or UAC scenario associated with FR-WSL-007.

requirements.statement: When SCM requests stop, the supervisor shall use the registered instance control command to deliver SIGTERM, allow the existing 8-second drain and 5-second gateway grace within a 15-second graceful budget, and report Stopped only after the owned unit exits or bounded escalation completes.
requirements.rationale: Traces the confirmed constraint or UAC scenario associated with FR-WSL-008.

requirements.statement: If graceful stop exceeds 15 seconds, the supervisor shall terminate only the owned wsl.exe child, wait 2 seconds, and only if the registered lock/health evidence persists shall invoke wsl.exe --terminate for the registration-bound distribution; it shall never invoke wsl.exe --shutdown.
requirements.rationale: Traces the confirmed constraint or UAC scenario associated with FR-WSL-009.

requirements.statement: Every forced WSL action shall name the registration-bound distribution, and the record shall never contain an all-distribution shutdown action, including on a machine with only one distribution.
requirements.rationale: Traces the confirmed constraint or UAC scenario associated with FR-WSL-010.

requirements.statement: When Windows resumes from sleep or hibernate, the supervisor shall invalidate pre-resume health evidence and start a fresh health probe within 10 seconds, recording its time, generation, and result.
requirements.rationale: Traces the confirmed constraint or UAC scenario associated with FR-WSL-011.

requirements.statement: When three consecutive 5-second-cadence health probes fail for the same live generation, the supervisor shall start a graceful restart without entering terminal Failed; a later successful health probe shall restore Ready.
requirements.rationale: Traces the confirmed constraint or UAC scenario associated with FR-WSL-012.

requirements.statement: If a graceful recovery restart exceeds the same 15-second shutdown budget and health remains failed, the supervisor shall skip child-only kill, terminate only the registration-bound distribution, and then restart from the pre-spawn probe.
requirements.rationale: Traces the confirmed constraint or UAC scenario associated with FR-WSL-013.

requirements.statement: When Automatic service start follows a Windows or WSL update reboot with no signed-in user, the supervisor shall run probe-before-spawn and readiness from the beginning and shall expose Ready only after status ok.
requirements.rationale: Traces the confirmed constraint or UAC scenario associated with FR-WSL-014.

requirements.statement: When the WSL subsystem becomes unavailable without a machine reboot, the supervisor shall retry as transient failure and shall not enter Failed before ten consecutive transient failures; recovery shall return to Ready without operator action.
requirements.rationale: Traces the confirmed constraint or UAC scenario associated with FR-WSL-015.

requirements.statement: The Windows record surface shall expose service start/stop, registration-bound Windows identity, distribution and Linux user, generation, readiness result, exit code, retry count, budget expiry, and escalation at %ProgramData%\AgentGrid\logs\wsl-host.log without secret, token, or environment values.
requirements.rationale: Traces the confirmed constraint or UAC scenario associated with FR-WSL-016.

requirements.statement: A transient failure shall not be terminal at the five-failure configuration threshold; only the tenth consecutive transient failure may enter Failed, and any intervening Ready result shall reset the transient counter.
requirements.rationale: Traces the confirmed constraint or UAC scenario associated with FR-WSL-017.

requirements.statement: The registration snapshot shall be the sole runtime authority for identity, distribution, Linux user, executable, data directory, address, TLS mode, health target, log path, and thresholds; interactive login and wsl --set-default changes shall not alter the running generation.
requirements.rationale: Traces the confirmed constraint or UAC scenario associated with FR-WSL-018.

non_functional_requirements.criteria: Configuration failures terminate after 5 attempts; transient failures terminate after 10; retry delays are 1,2,5,15,60 seconds capped at 60.
non_functional_requirements.measurement: Fake-clock T0/T1 tests and Windows/WSL T3 timestamps.

non_functional_requirements.criteria: Health request timeout is 2 seconds, cadence 5 seconds, resume recheck begins within 10 seconds, startup readiness budget is 60 seconds, and graceful stop budget is 15 seconds.
non_functional_requirements.measurement: Fake-clock deterministic tests plus FakeVsReal Windows duration measurements.

non_functional_requirements.criteria: Config is administrator/service-identity readable only; logs are service-writable and operator-readable; no raw child stdout/stderr, token, secret, or environment value is persisted.
non_functional_requirements.measurement: ACL fidelity test and adversarial record scan.

non_functional_requirements.criteria: SCM, WSL command execution, process inspection/signalling, HTTP health, filesystem/ACL, clock, resume notification, and record sink are injected boundaries.

acceptance.given: a previously Ready configuration suffers transient failures
acceptance.when: five failures occur and the cause then clears

adrs.title: Bind WSL supervisor target at registration in an atomic JSON snapshot
adrs.context: The UX consultation confirmed registration-time binding. Runtime default lookup would redirect launch and terminate authority. TOML is only an Explore candidate and persistence types must remain stdlib-only.
adrs.decision: Store versioned JSON under %ProgramData%\AgentGrid\wsl-host-supervisor.json using temp-file, fsync, rename, ACL validation, and generation fingerprint. Explicit identity/distro override defaults; omitted values are resolved once during registration. Apply requires stop, validate, atomic replace, then start.
consequences: Positive: One immutable generation controls launch, health, stop, and records.
Negative: Target changes require an explicit stop/apply/start operation.
Neutral: Existing host flags remain unchanged and are projected from the JSON snapshot.

alternatives.why_not: Adds a third-party codec and duplicates host launch values.
Breaks registration-bound target and stop authority.

status_provenance.rationale: ユーザーが7件すべての採用と代替案の却下理由を明示的に承認した。

adrs.title: Launch the host server by direct foreground wsl.exe --exec
adrs.context: Foreground supervision requires child exit ownership and no residual shell. The original plan names direct exec as the primary form.
adrs.decision: Launch wsl.exe --distribution <bound> --user <bound> --exec <server> with explicit host flags as the long-lived child. Do not insert cmd.exe, powershell, sh -c, a background process, or a launcher. Environment-dependent setup must become explicit argv/config, not a shell.
consequences: Positive: The process tree and exit code have one owner and UAC-003 is directly testable.
Negative: Future environment setup must be represented as configuration or reconsider this ADR.
Neutral: Graceful stop uses the separate Linux control command, not Windows signal propagation through wsl.exe.

alternatives.why_not: Unneeded for the confirmed explicit argv/config surface and creates another deployed artifact.
Destroys exit ownership and causes false restart loops.

status_provenance.rationale: ユーザーが7件すべての採用と代替案の却下理由を明示的に承認した。

adrs.title: Do not apply the WSL detach spike to the foreground supervised service unit
adrs.context: The accepted detach ADR solves a short-lived Windows launcher whose Linux daemon must outlive it. This service is deliberately a long-lived parent whose child must not outlive supervision.
adrs.decision: Treat adr-20260724-boundary-3-wsl-detach-spike as non-applicable, not superseded: no setsid or nohup is used in this service topology. Its accepted decision remains valid for Windows Shell Phase 2 only.
consequences: Positive: Foreground ownership is explicit without weakening the accepted ADR in its own scope.
Negative: The service cannot reuse the Shell's detach invocation.
Neutral: adr-20260724-boundary-3-adopt-before-spawn remains applicable; the toast-separation ADR remains outside this GUI-free component.

alternatives.why_not: Would sever the lifecycle and stop ownership required here.
Incorrect because its original boundary and evidence remain valid.

status_provenance.rationale: ユーザーが7件すべての採用と代替案の却下理由を明示的に承認した。

adrs.title: Probe before spawn and adopt only a fingerprint-matched locked host instance
adrs.context: The accepted adopt-before-spawn ADR forbids learning adoption from a failed spawn. Stop ownership must also be explicit.
adrs.decision: Before every spawn, invoke the additive Linux supervisor-probe command for the bound data directory and health target. It returns typed JSON and exit classes after checking flock holder PID, Linux start token, executable, argv fingerprint, and health. matched_running is adopted with stop authority bound to that token; absent alone permits one spawn; mismatch is configuration failure; unavailable/unknown is transient and never permits spawn. supervisor-stop revalidates the token before SIGTERM.
consequences: Positive: Adoption, spawn permission, and stop authority derive from one typed identity proof.
Negative: Adds two additive Linux CLI operations and /proc-based fidelity requirements.
Neutral: The pid stored in the lock remains human-readable; authority additionally uses start token and fingerprint.

alternatives.option: Parse spawn stderr for flock refusal
Adopt healthy endpoint without process fingerprint
alternatives.why_not: Cannot establish data-dir identity or stop authority.
Would make SCM Stopped while the required endpoint remains alive.

status_provenance.rationale: ユーザーが7件すべての採用と代替案の却下理由を明示的に承認した。

adrs.title: Use typed failure classes and fixed two-stage health and terminal thresholds
adrs.context: The UX requires configuration, transient, already-running, and unknown outcomes to remain discriminating and requires different restart and terminal thresholds.
adrs.decision: Use health URL and TLS mode projected from the same bound addr/config. Probe timeout 2s, cadence 5s, startup readiness 60s, resume probe start <=10s, health restart threshold 3, configuration terminal threshold 5, transient/unknown terminal threshold 10, and retry schedule 1,2,5,15,60 seconds capped at 60. Ready resets both counters. status ok alone is healthy; daemon-unavailable is unhealthy.
consequences: Positive: Recovery and terminal time are bounded and fake-clock testable.
Negative: Numerical policy changes require a new design decision and operational retest.
Neutral: SCM Running does not encode Ready/Backoff/Failed; health plus records remain the read model.

alternatives.why_not: Fails UAC-017 and hides classifier errors.
Can drift from the server addr.

status_provenance.rationale: ユーザーが7件すべての採用と代替案の却下理由を明示的に承認した。

adrs.title: Use a 15-second graceful budget before registered-distro-only escalation
adrs.context: UX handoff DP-SHUTDOWN-TIMEOUT-PROVENANCE leaves the numeric source to design and recommends OPT-DERIVE-FROM-SERVER-BUDGET. The server drains for 8 seconds and then its gateway has a 5-second grace; the ungrounded 30-second proposal is not adopted.
adrs.decision: Use one 15-second graceful shutdown budget for SCM stop and recovery restart: 8s drain + 5s gateway grace + 2s supervised-unit exit overhead. SCM stop then terminates the owned child, waits 2s, and conditionally terminates the bound distro. Recovery restart skips child-only kill after 15s and directly terminates the bound distro, matching UAC-013. Never call wsl --shutdown.
consequences: Positive: The budget is derived from existing shutdown behavior and shared by both paths.
Negative: A stuck recovery can disrupt every process in the bound distribution.
Neutral: The service reports SCM stop-pending checkpoints while the bounded sequence runs.

alternatives.why_not: Has no repository derivation and needlessly delays SCM.
Interrupts gateway grace and unit exit.
Contradicts the confirmed recovery escalation scenario.

status_provenance.rationale: ユーザーが7件すべての採用と代替案の却下理由を明示的に承認した。

adrs.title: Write structured records under ProgramData with bounded retention and SCM pre-start complement
adrs.context: Consultation selected a dedicated file, but a profile-relative path is not operator-reachable and no process can log before SCM creates it.
adrs.decision: Use %ProgramData%\AgentGrid\logs\wsl-host.log as primary structured JSON-lines record. ACL: SYSTEM and Administrators full control, configured service identity modify, BUILTIN\Users read on logs only. Rotate at 10 MiB, keep 5 files, delete files older than 30 days. Persist only allowlisted supervisor fields and never raw stdout/stderr, argv secrets, tokens, or environment values. Pre-process failures are read through SCM's System event record and documented sc query/event lookup.
consequences: Positive: Records are deterministic, operator-reachable, bounded, and structurally redacted.
Negative: Raw child diagnostics are not retained by the Windows supervisor.
Neutral: The Linux host retains its own existing logs; SCM owns failures before process creation.

alternatives.option: Windows Event Log as primary sink
alternatives.why_not: Rejected by user consultation; retain only SCM's unavoidable pre-start complement.
Not reliably reachable from the signed-in operator profile.
Cannot prove arbitrary application output contains no secret.

status_provenance.rationale: ユーザーが7件すべての採用と代替案の却下理由を明示的に承認した。

decision_dispositions.rationale: Registration-time binding is confirmed and closed by the atomic JSON snapshot ADR.
Direct foreground wsl.exe --exec is fixed; no launcher or shell remains.
The accepted detach ADR is explicitly non-applicable to a long-lived foreground parent.
Typed pre-spawn lock/process fingerprinting establishes adoption and stop authority.
Health target and all retry/readiness thresholds are fixed from the bound snapshot.
The selected dedicated log is concretized with ProgramData path, ACL, retention and SCM complement.
Adopt OPT-DERIVE-FROM-SERVER-BUDGET: 8-second drain plus 5-second gateway grace plus 2-second measured unit-exit allowance yields the single 15-second graceful budget.

resolved_issues.resolution: Separated confirmed UX constraints/consultations from provisional handoff seeds; design choices are newly proposed ADRs and change remains draft.
Restored golang x/sys/windows/svc, JSON-vs-TOML, Event Log complement, dedicated log, and baseline comparisons in ADR alternatives and implementation seams.
Fixed typed supervisor-probe before every spawn; only determinate absence permits spawn.
Selected direct foreground wsl.exe --exec and rejected launcher/detach paths.
Fingerprint-matched lock holder plus PID start token grants bounded adopted stop authority; token is revalidated before SIGTERM.
Translated UAC-001..017 into FR/acceptance rows and a verification trace matrix.
Assigned all 11 dimensions to owner components, task units, typed failure, witnesses, and Tier verification.

reference_algorithms.pseudocode: serialize event; discard if event.generation != current; on start probe before spawn; matched=>adopt, absent=>spawn once, mismatch=>config failure, unknown=>transient; Ready only on status ok; third health failure=>graceful restart; config count 5=>Failed; transient count 10=>Failed; Ready resets counters; resume invalidates health and schedules immediate probe.
bounds: At most one spawn, health request and timer per generation.
All terminal partitions are exhaustive and mutually exclusive.

reference_algorithms.pseudocode: revalidate token; invoke supervisor-stop(SIGTERM); report pending checkpoints while waiting <=15s; if exited finish; if SCM-stop terminate owned child, wait 2s, probe, and terminate bound distro only if evidence persists; if recovery terminate bound distro immediately after 15s; after terminate re-probe absence before reporting completion; never invoke --shutdown.
bounds: Graceful wait 15s; optional child wait 2s; one bound-distro terminate.
Duplicate/late stop controls cannot start another transaction.
failure_cases: Ownership mismatch aborts signal and broad termination.
Terminate failure is recorded and SCM receives a non-success terminal result.
Unrelated distributions are never enumerated or targeted.

decision_inputs.subject: Registration-time identity and distribution binding
decision_inputs.candidate: Resolve explicit values or registration-time defaults once, persist them as the service snapshot, and require re-registration or an explicit apply operation to change them.
decision_inputs.comparison_baseline: Resolve WSL default distribution and interactive identity again at every service start.

decision_inputs.subject: Foreground WSL launch invocation
decision_inputs.candidate: Use direct wsl.exe --exec or a launcher ending in exec, selected only after proving signal and exit propagation with a long-lived SCM parent.
decision_inputs.comparison_baseline: A detached shell/launcher that can outlive or obscure the supervised unit.

decision_inputs.subject: setsid/nohup detach behavior from the WSL detach spike ADR
decision_inputs.candidate: Do not apply setsid/nohup detach behavior to this service because the supervisor must remain a long-lived parent that observes the foreground unit's lifecycle and owns bounded stop escalation.
decision_inputs.comparison_baseline: The ADR's measured short-lived launch-origin context, where detached process survival is the objective.

decision_inputs.subject: Already-running refusal classification and adoption ownership
decision_inputs.candidate: Use a proven flock-refusal signal to record already-running and continue health evaluation; leave whether the service owns later stop of the adopted instance as a separate design choice.
decision_inputs.comparison_baseline: Classify every launch refusal as permanent configuration failure or crash.

decision_inputs.subject: Health target and data-dir configuration source
decision_inputs.candidate: Derive the health target from the same persisted launch configuration that provides server -addr and -data-dir, accepting only /healthz status ok.
decision_inputs.comparison_baseline: A supervisor-only fixed localhost port or a separate health URL that can drift from server launch arguments.

decision_inputs.subject: Operator-reachable dedicated log with pre-start failure complement
decision_inputs.candidate: Use the selected dedicated rotating log at a machine-wide operator-readable path, with SCM/OS service-start records for failures before the supervisor can open the file.
decision_inputs.comparison_baseline: A profile-relative service-account log file alone, or Windows Event Log as the primary sink.

decision_inputs.subject: Graceful shutdown wait budget provenance

candidates.description: Derive one budget from the existing 8-second server drain, 5-second gateway grace, and measured supervised-unit exit overhead.
Use the original plan's ungrounded 30-second example.
